Indian Express Investigation | The Centre repeatedly flagged Delhi's shortage of mechanised road sweeping machines, set a target of 505 machines, proposed monitoring mechanisms and eventually fixed September 2026 as the deadline to complete procurement.
But how did these directions unfold?
In this Express Investigation, Sophiya Mathew examines records from November 2025 to September 2026 to trace the Centre's instructions to Delhi — from identifying road-wise requirements and tracking machine performance to expanding the fleet and completing procurement.
